canonical_name: Caffarelli theorem (interior regularity of convex Monge-Ampere solutions)
candidate_claim_family: Interior regularity for convex generalized solutions u of det(D^2 u) = f (equivalently, with controlled Monge-Ampere measure), under positive upper and lower density bounds; possible conclusions include strict convexity, local C^{1,alpha}, local W^{2,p}, and, with stronger f, local C^{2,alpha}.
domain_and_universes: Candidate domain: a finite-dimensional real Euclidean space of dimension at least two, a convex open domain, and a real-valued convex function; exact universes and types are not frozen.
candidate_conclusion_branches: local C^{2,alpha} under stronger density regularity

a finite-dimensional convexity lemma presented as the terminal PDE theorem
